find:
/* The eighth scrim, and the one that is not the night sky. This renders only in the trade
     ticket's review phase, which sits behind two clicks and no check has reached, and it sits on
     the ticket's #F5F6FA panel rather than on the dark scene /apply paints. So it takes the triple
     and not a veil: the veils are weights measured against that scene, and against a light panel
     this composites to a mid grey around (149, 150, 160) — a 0.1 step here is dE 9.3 where the same
     step on the sky is 2, so it would be a different decision wearing a name that promises this one.
     That it shares a literal with seven night-sky scrims is a strong hint it is a dark-ground
     leftover, the way .legendMark was. It cannot be confirmed until the review phase is measurable,
     so it is left alone and said out loud rather than converted on a guess. */
  background: rgba(var(--pk-space-edge-rgb), 0.4);
replace:
/* One step in from the ticket's panel, the way a well sits in a card. */
  background: var(--pk-panel-3);
